name: tidepost

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build && node scripts/write-version-json.mjs packages/client/out/version.json
scripts.build:client: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

description: Self-hosted Instagram scheduler that runs on your own Cloudflare account.

SETUP_CODE.description: A long secret phrase (at least 12 characters). You type it once on your first visit to register your passkey. Keep a copy: change it later to register a new passkey if you lose yours.
